text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: The PDP-1 was introduced in 1959 by Digital Equipment Corporation and was one of the earliest interactive computers. It featured a graphical display, keyboard input, and support for user-created programs. The system is historically significant for running Spacewar!, one of the first computer games, created by researchers at MIT in 1962. The PDP-1 influenced later interactive computing systems and demonstrated the potential of computers as creative and entertainment devices.
